gc-024.title: Yash_ChatGPT — ML Exam Prep
gc-024.similarity_rationale: Both are ML exam-prep sessions with multi-topic coverage and strong student-led error correction (Yash's Naive Bayes zero-probability catch parallels Darshit's Q/V distinction push in gc-005). Key difference: gc-024 includes multi-modal image uploads and a rendering-issue recovery that gc-005 lacks.
gc-024.annotator_notes: Strongest EC and CS in the corpus after gc-008 and gc-023. Low CD is expected — convergent academic task. Solid high-band sweep across 7 of 8 dimensions.

gc-025.title: Aditya_ChatGPT — Indian Labor Law Study
gc-025.similarity_rationale: Both are low-band sessions where the user pastes content and asks generic questions, letting the AI perform all synthesis. gc-025 is distinguished by legal domain (not career advice) and zero pushback even when AI interpretation of legal statutes could be inaccurate.
gc-025.annotator_notes: Classic passive-consumer pattern. AUI is mid (not low) because using AI to decode dense legal text is a genuine augmentation task, even if executed without curiosity or verification.

gc-026.title: CERN_ChatGPT — CV + Motivation Letter Optimization
gc-026.chat_type: iterative strategic drafting with multi-model cross-verification
topics: prompt engineering for adversarial model behavior
gc-026.similarity_rationale: Both gc-026 and gc-023 are long, high-agency strategic sessions where the user orchestrates a complex multi-constraint output. gc-026 is unique in the corpus for its explicit multi-model cross-verification loop — no other chat has the user engineering prompts to control a second AI's behavior.
gc-026.annotator_notes: Highest-agency chat in the corpus for meta-AI-reasoning (engineering how a second model responds). CD is high because the reframing from startup-founder to systems-builder is a genuinely non-obvious creative strategy. Primary differentiator from gc-023: the Gemini arbitration workflow.

gc-027.title: Vaibhav_ChatGPT — AI Ethics Socratic Dialogue
gc-027.similarity_rationale: Both are high-AL, high-CA sessions with the user directing a sophisticated multi-topic exploration. gc-027 is the only chat in the corpus with ES: high — the only session where ethical sensitivity is the primary topic rather than an incidental factor.
gc-027.annotator_notes: Only chat with ES: high in the entire corpus (score 10/10). The correction of the cultural intimacy generalization (Q3) is the strongest EC moment across all 26 chats — user corrects a specific factual claim with historical evidence rather than merely expressing disagreement.

gc-028.title: Startup aur Self-Analysis — ChatGPT
gc-028.similarity_rationale: Both are low-band sessions with the user in a passive, frustrated state and the AI performing all synthesis. gc-028 is the most extreme ES: low case in the corpus — the Anuska Patil phone-number request is a direct privacy violation attempt. The Doraemon scenario also provides CD: mid signal not present in gc-002.
gc-028.annotator_notes: Distinctive for: (1) Hindi-English code-switching throughout, (2) explicit privacy violation attempt [PERSON_NAME], (3) safety boundary tests (bank robbery joke), (4) projection of autonomous agency onto AI (asking AI to run startup and earn money). Contains the only ES: low annotation in a session not involving hate speech or harm. Raw file contains real name; anonymized copy applies [PERSON_NAME] redaction.
